summary: Day 12.5 testing complete — Verdict Engine math fix, 3-tier system, monetization gate, and robust fallback all working correctly. 21/21 backend tests pass. Frontend UI verified with Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: Three-tier system correctly implemented: TIER1_MAX=50, TIER2_MAX=200, no TIER3_HARD
Verdict math uses normalized ratios: market_perf = ebay_avg/MSRP, internal_perf = actual_hit_rate/expected_baseline
When pack_cost_source='msrp_fallback', market_perf correctly defaults to 1.0 (neutral)
Verdict thresholds correct: final_score >= 1.05 → DUB, >= 0.70 → MID, < 0.70 → TRASH
Monetization gate working: free tier gets 403 after 2 packs/week with correct error shape
Pro users and trial users have unlimited access
ConfidenceBadge shows 3 dots (not 4) based on tier
IntelligencePanel shows Market perf, Hit-rate perf, Final score ratios
seed_data_creation: Test users created with TEST_ prefix during testing, cleaned up after
context_for_next_testing_agent: Day 12.5 features fully tested: (1) GET /api/analyzer/{pack_id} returns verdict with intelligence block containing confidence.{tier,label,market_weight,pull_weight}, market_perf, internal_perf, final_score, expected_hit_rate_baseline. (2) Three-tier system: Tier 1 (<50 pulls) = Market Only 100/0, Tier 2 (50-200) = Market Verified 80/20, Tier 3 (>=200) = Community Hardened 50/50. (3) Verdict math: market_perf=1.0 on msrp_fallback (neutral), final_score drives rating (>=1.05 DUB, >=0.70 MID, <0.70 TRASH). (4) Monetization gate: free tier 403 after 2 packs/week with error='free_tier_limit', message contains 'Go Pro to Unlock', cta_url='/vault'. (5) Frontend: ConfidenceBadge shows 3 dots, IntelligencePanel shows perf ratios, paywall renders on 403 with GO PRO button.

verdict_math_fix.notes: market_perf and internal_perf are unitless ratios. final_score = weighted blend. Neutral baseline (msrp_fallback) gives MID, not TRASH.

three_tier_system.notes: TIER1_MAX=50, TIER2_MAX=200. Tier 3 'Community Hardened' at >=200 pulls with 50/50 weights.

monetization_gate.notes: Free tier limited to 2 packs/week. 403 response has correct shape with error, message, cta_url, limit, used fields.

robust_fallback.notes: All 8 hot packs return 200, never 500. Invalid pack returns 404.

confidence_badge_ui.notes: Shows 3 dots (not 4) filled based on tier. Tier 1 = 1 dot filled.

intelligence_panel_ui.notes: Shows Market perf, Hit-rate perf, Final score when final_score is present.

paywall_ui.notes: Renders analyzer-paywall element on 403 with 'GO PRO TO UNLOCK' button and usage counter.
